Two rotations swept together, showing the two forms of `join`: a bare name joins at the roster minimum, `name=number` at that score. In `primary`, erin and frank join bare on 2026-09-14. At that instant carol has just been credited for the current shift, so the scores are alice 28, bob 28, carol 28, dave 21: both start at 21, the minimum. Dave, erin and frank tie at 21 for 09-14 and the order tiebreak after carol picks dave; erin takes 09-21 and frank 09-28; then all six are level at 28 and the walk wraps to alice, bob. In `secondary` (erin, frank, gina, all 35 after gina's current shift), hank joins bare at the minimum 35 and takes 09-14 as the next in order; on 09-21 ivan joins with the number 42 and judy with 30, so judy is the lowest and takes 09-21, after which the walk continues from the top with erin, frank, gina while ivan (42) stays out of the band.
